metadata.question: Compare the experiments reported for OPT-1.3B and explain how their evaluation conditions limit the comparison.

UNVERIFIED EVALUATION BASELINE

The supplied evidence does not contain any experiment results specific to OPT-1.3B; the only OPT model mentioned is OPT-6.7B. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

The calibration-set robustness experiments reported in Figure 8 were all run with the OPT-6.7B model under INT3-g128 quantization, not OPT-1.3B. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

In those OPT-6.7B experiments, using the same calibration and evaluation distribution (PubMed-PubMed, Enron-Enron) worked best overall. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

When calibration and evaluation distributions differed (PubMed-Enron, Enron-PubMed), AWQ increased perplexity by only 0.5-0.6, whereas GPTQ showed 2.3-4.9 worse perplexity. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

Because the available evidence covers only OPT-6.7B under a single INT3-g128 setting, no comparison of OPT-1.3B experiments can be supported. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

claim.text: The supplied evidence does not contain any experiment results specific to OPT-1.3B; the only OPT model mentioned is OPT-6.7B.
The calibration-set robustness experiments reported in Figure 8 were all run with the OPT-6.7B model under INT3-g128 quantization, not OPT-1.3B.
In those OPT-6.7B experiments, using the same calibration and evaluation distribution (PubMed-PubMed, Enron-Enron) worked best overall.
When calibration and evaluation distributions differed (PubMed-Enron, Enron-PubMed), AWQ increased perplexity by only 0.5-0.6, whereas GPTQ showed 2.3-4.9 worse perplexity.
Because the available evidence covers only OPT-6.7B under a single INT3-g128 setting, no comparison of OPT-1.3B experiments can be supported.

UNVERIFIED EVALUATION BASELINE

在 OPT-1.3B 上，FP16 的困惑度为 14.62。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

在 OPT-1.3B 上，RTN 量化（3-bit，group size 128）的困惑度为 119.47。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

在 OPT-1.3B 上，1% FP16 混合精度的困惑度为 16.91。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

在 OPT-1.3B 上，AWQ 的困惑度为 16.32。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

在 OPT-1.3B 上，缩放方法 s = 2 的困惑度为 18.63。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

表 3 中的量化实验使用 3-bit 量化，group size 为 128。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

AWQ 通过基于缩放的方法保护显著权重并降低量化误差，其表现持续优于 RTN，并达到与 1% FP16 混合精度相当的性能，同时更利于硬件实现。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

关于校准集数据效率与分布鲁棒性的实验（图 8）是在 OPT-6.7B 模型上、INT3-g128 量化下进行的，而非 OPT-1.3B。 [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5] [b5d68792-380e-4461-9473-24a420b372a6]

分析显著通道缩放（s 取值）的实验是在 OPT-6.7B 模型上进行的，因此这些结果不能直接用于说明 OPT-1.3B 的行为。 [a111c0e9-0159-4d4a-849d-e5cfd1c85d8b]

OPT-1.3B 的对比仅限于表 3 中单一量化设置（3-bit、group size 128）下的困惑度，因此其评估条件范围较窄。 [4884585b-da17-4419-9f3b-f5f6ba7b70fa]

runs.answer:
UNVERIFIED EVALUATION BASELINE

Table 1 reports OPT-1.3B WikiText perplexity under INT3 quantization with group size 128, comparing FP16, RTN, and keeping small fractions of weights in FP16 selected by activation, weight, or random criteria. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, the FP16 baseline achieves a WikiText perplexity of 14.62. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, RTN (w3-g128) yields a WikiText perplexity of 119.0. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, keeping 0.1% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 25.03. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, keeping 1% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 16.91. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, keeping 3% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 16.68. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

For OPT-1.3B, keeping 0.1% of weights in FP16 selected by weight magnitude gives a WikiText perplexity of 108.71. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

The paper states that keeping a small fraction of weights (0.1%-1%) in FP16 significantly improves quantized model performance over RTN, and that this is only effective when important weights are selected by activation distribution rather than weight distribution. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243]

Table 9 reports WikiText-2 perplexity of OPT models under INT2-g64 quantization, comparing FP16, RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ+GPTQ. [19719107-d298-4eb5-983d-3f0707464111] [f2582866-fb7c-4812-8f3b-2484e02ef6d4]

The OPT-1.3B experiments in Table 1 and Table 9 differ in quantization configuration (INT3-g128 versus INT2-g64) and in the methods compared, so their perplexity values are not directly comparable across tables. [f3f9c4f7-426e-4d42-9cdf-f8505de5a243] [19719107-d298-4eb5-983d-3f0707464111]

The calibration-set robustness experiments described in the text and Figure 8 use the OPT-6.7B model under INT3-g128 quantization, not OPT-1.3B. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5] [022dbe89-5c36-4e74-bb60-f4d1a5db660f]

claim.text: Table 1 reports OPT-1.3B WikiText perplexity under INT3 quantization with group size 128, comparing FP16, RTN, and keeping small fractions of weights in FP16 selected by activation, weight, or random criteria.
For OPT-1.3B, the FP16 baseline achieves a WikiText perplexity of 14.62.
For OPT-1.3B, RTN (w3-g128) yields a WikiText perplexity of 119.0.
For OPT-1.3B, keeping 0.1% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 25.03.
For OPT-1.3B, keeping 1% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 16.91.
For OPT-1.3B, keeping 3% of weights in FP16 selected by activation gives a WikiText perplexity of 16.68.
For OPT-1.3B, keeping 0.1% of weights in FP16 selected by weight magnitude gives a WikiText perplexity of 108.71.

The paper states that keeping a small fraction of weights (0.1%-1%) in FP16 significantly improves quantized model performance over RTN, and that this is only effective when important weights are selected by activation distribution rather than weight distribution.
Table 9 reports WikiText-2 perplexity of OPT models under INT2-g64 quantization, comparing FP16, RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ+GPTQ.

The OPT-1.3B experiments in Table 1 and Table 9 differ in quantization configuration (INT3-g128 versus INT2-g64) and in the methods compared, so their perplexity values are not directly comparable across tables.
The calibration-set robustness experiments described in the text and Figure 8 use the OPT-6.7B model under INT3-g128 quantization, not OPT-1.3B.
